references.text: The angel of the Lord first appeared to the woman, who now tells her husband about it
Gideon also experienced fear at the sight of God's angel, similar to the awe described here
Jacob also asked for the name of the divine figure he met, but received no answer
The angel of the Lord appears, as here to Manoah's wife
The description of the angel's awe-inspiring appearance recalls the radiant presence of angels
An angel appears to Zechariah with a message about a son, similar to the situation with Manoah's wife
Daniel also describes fear at the sight of a heavenly figure
Ezekiel describes the awe-inspiring nature of God's glorious appearance
